The copper-clad statue, a gift to the United States from the people of France
Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux, who had designed Central Park's Greensward Plan, were commissioned to produce a design for the park
items.note: Central Park is right, but Olmsted and Vaux also designed Morningside Park, another Manhattan park (this quote), and Olmsted designed Riverside Park. A room answering Morningside Park is correct as worded. Suggested rewording: "Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux won an 1858 design competition with their 'Greensward Plan' for which Manhattan park?" (en:Central_Park).

items.quote: The New York Yankees are an American professional baseball team based in the New York City borough of the Bronx
New Amsterdam ( , ) was a 17th-century Dutch settlement established at the southern tip of Manhattan Island
items.note: New Amsterdam is the expected answer, but the same article says that when the Dutch recaptured the city in 1673-74 it was 'again renamed, this time to New Orange', so a pedant has a second Dutch-era name. Suggested rewording: "What was New York called when the Dutch founded it as a colonial settlement in the 1620s?"
